changelog: - **One choke point for object-URL previews (#1005)** — `objectUrlSrc()` renders only `blob:` URLs and drops anything else, used by every attachment/image preview. It is redundant at runtime (the browser, not the file, produces the scheme, and `` cannot execute SVG) but it puts that invariant in code instead of leaving it as a comment on three call sites, and `docs/security-exceptions.md` now records the reasoning under a new code-scanning section.
